name: flow
description: A local-first AI worklog for macOS.
author: Matt Tengtrakool

scripts.electron:dev: pnpm electron:build:main && concurrently -k "vite --config vite.config.ts" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && FLOW_APP_PROFILE=dev electron ."
scripts.electron:dev:prod-data: pnpm electron:build:main && concurrently -k "vite --config vite.config.ts" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && FLOW_APP_PROFILE=prod electron ."
scripts.electron:dist: pnpm native-capture:build && pnpm native-audio:build && pnpm electron:build && electron-builder --mac dir --mac zip
scripts.electron:dist:dev: pnpm native-capture:build && pnpm native-audio:build && pnpm electron:build && FLOW_APP_PROFILE=dev electron-builder --mac dir --mac zip --config.appId=com.flow.worklog.dev --config.productName="Flow Dev" --config.directories.output=release-dev
scripts.electron:dist:dmg: pnpm native-capture:build && pnpm native-audio:build && pnpm electron:build && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.native-capture:build: mkdir -p electron/native-capture/build && xcrun clang++ -std=c++17 -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices -framework CoreGraphics -framework ScreenCaptureKit -framework Vision electron/native-capture/FlowNativeCapture.mm -o electron/native-capture/build/FlowNativeCapture
scripts.native-audio:build: mkdir -p electron/native-audio/build && xcrun clang++ -std=c++17 -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation -framework AVFoundation -framework CoreGraphics -framework ScreenCaptureKit electron/native-audio/FlowAudioCapture.mm -o electron/native-audio/build/FlowAudioCapture
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
